description: This file contains shell script functions for configuring U-Boot environment variables via UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) on OpenWrt. It defines functions to add U-Boot environment configurations, both for U-Boot environment variables and system configurations, as well as app-specific configurations, manipulating configuration files and UCI settings.

methods.name: _ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Internal function to add U-Boot environment configuration via UCI batch commands.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Public wrapper to add U-Boot environment configuration for a specified config type.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_sys_config
methods.description: Wrapper to add system configuration U-Boot environment.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_app_config
methods.description: Adds app-specific U-Boot environment configuration by updating associated config files based on parameters.
